## Out-of-scope check

Passoff is intentionally one primitive: discrete handoffs. It is **not** a memory layer, an orchestrator, a dashboard, or a cloud service. If your feature pulls Passoff toward any of those, please say why it still belongs here. See [docs/design.md](../../docs/design.md).
